Intergrated Home Africa Annual Report 2017
PROPOSED PROJECT 2
Yellow Wood PDS
The PDS is nested by hole 16 on the Eastern side, hole 15 and 17 on the southern side and
Gplots on the Northern side. The PDS is set for subdivision of plot sizes measuring approximately
0.0505 Ha. The plots will be overlooking the fairway and others on backrow. The plots are to
be sold out to individuals to make their own development.
